reviews.review_description: Should you get this game? yeah it's free. It has some minor issues but this could easily be 5/5. The two maps are fun with museum being the highlight. Playground is solid but some people can hide behind objects that seekers are unable to reach. This can be fixed by doing more map drops maybe monthly or biweekly. In the lobby of a match anyone can adjust the match settings which could mess with the round. It's a good vr game with continued support could be major app on quest. Also maybe add a server browser similar to forefront I joined the same public match 3 times back to back not sure if this was a lack of active matches or regional.

developer_response.body:
Hey there, glad to hear your thoughts! We've already got multiple maps in the works and coming soon, as well as many more features and even modes. Happy to have you along for the ride that will be the Grablings' multiversal adventures!

-TL
